rows.ja: 電力・AIデータセンターの顧客
提携・事業のつながり
競合:電力(ガスタービン等)

relations.text: GE Vernova・KiewitのTICと、最大5.4GWのガス火力複合発電を開発する契約
relations.text_en: Project development agreement with GE Vernova and Kiewit’s TIC for up to 5.4GW of gas-fired combined-cycle projects

source.label: NRG Energy 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: NRG has entered into slot reservation agreements with GEV for the procurement of 3.6 GW of 7HA gas turbines.
source.note: 最大5.4GWの契約で、枠の予約を含みます。最初の案件は2029年末までの見込みです。
source.note_en: Up to 5.4GW including slot reservations; first projects expected by end of 2029.

relations.text: Mill Creek 5号機向けに7HA.03複合発電設備を受注
relations.text_en: Order for 7HA.03 combined-cycle equipment for the Mill Creek Unit 5 project

source.label: GE Vernova の発表(2024年4月)
source.quote: today announced it has secured an order for its 7HA.03 combined-cycle plant equipment from Louisville Gas and Electric Company and Kentucky Utilities Company (LG&E and KU)
source.note: 完成は2027年の見込みです。

relations.text: AWSのデータセンター拡大を支える戦略的な枠組み契約
relations.text_en: Strategic framework agreement to support AWS data center scaling

source.label: GE Vernova の発表(2025年3月)
source.quote: GE Vernova will continue to provide AWS with turnkey substation solutions to enable connectivity of AWS data centers to the grid

relations.text: 米データセンター向けの電力開発で提携し、最初の案件にGE Vernovaの7HAタービン7基を使う見込み
relations.text_en: Partnership to power U.S. data centers; first projects expected to use seven GE Vernova 7HA turbines

source.label: Chevron の発表(2025年1月、GE Vernovaサイトに掲載)
source.label_en: Chevron newsroom page fetched at gevernova.com URL (Jan 2025)
source.quote: The first projects, which the companies refer to as “power foundries”, are expected to leverage seven U.S. made GE Vernova 7HA natural gas turbines, secured under a slot reservation agreement
source.note: 計画・枠の予約の段階で、確定注文ではありません。
source.note_en: Expected/planned; slot reservations, not final orders.

relations.text: 小型モジュール炉(SMR)の設計・開発を日立との合弁で手がける
relations.text_en: Small modular reactors are designed and developed through joint ventures with Hitachi

source.label: GE Vernova 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: through joint ventures with Hitachi, Ltd.

relations.text: 航空転用エンジンの保守を支える折半出資の合弁「Aero Alliance」
relations.text_en: Aero Alliance: 50-50 joint venture for aeroderivative engine support

source.label: GE Vernova 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Aero Alliance is our 50 - 50 joint venture with Baker Hughes Company that supports our customers through the fulfillment of aeroderivative engines, spare parts, repairs, and maintenance services.

relations.text: Baker Hughesが年次報告で、GE Vernovaの知的財産を使うガスタービンの販売・供給契約を記載
relations.text_en: Baker Hughes’ annual report describes a gas turbine distribution and supply agreement licensing GE Vernova IP

source.label: Baker Hughes 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: a heavy duty gas turbine distribution and supply agreement that licenses certain intellectual property of GE Vernova to Baker Hughes

relations.text: 2024年4月2日にGeneral Electricから分離独立。「GE」の名称はライセンスで使用
relations.text_en: Spun off from General Electric on April 2, 2024; uses the GE name under license

source.label: GE Vernova 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: we have a license to use certain IP from GE , including the GE name and the GE Monogram.

relations.text: Duke Energyが、GE Vernovaの7HAガスタービン20基を数年かけて受け取る契約に署名(GE Vernovaの記事)
relations.text_en: Duke Energy has signed an agreement for 20 new GE Vernova 7HA gas-power turbines, to be delivered over several years (GE Vernova article)

source.label: GE Vernova の記事
source.quote: has signed an agreement for 20 new 7HA gas-power turbines aimed to be delivered over the next several years
source.note: 納入は数年にわたります。記事に日付の記載はありません。
source.note_en: Delivery is over several years; the article carries no date.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
